name: app-sage-and-olive-nav-bar-variants-in-light-and-dark
title: Sage and Olive Navigation Bar Variants
whatItIs: Eight rounded navigation cards on a pale sage field: light cream and dark olive versions of a top bar with a logo, search and text tabs (Routes highlighted as a pill or underlined) and an icon tab bar (Profile, Social, Notifications, Settings) with the active item in a pill or bolder tone.
whatItMeans: A single earthy green family across light and dark variants feels natural and cohesive, and pill versus underline shows two ways to mark active.
techniques: Light and dark versions in one family of greens
Active tab as a pill or as an underline
Text tabs and icon tabs as separate variants
Logo and search in the top bar

vocabulary.definition: A filled rounded shape behind the selected tab.
A line under the selected tab.
A palette built from shades of one hue.
